column1: # The places the asset library's tree begins with, as Blender's file
# browser and Reality Composer Pro's navigator have them: its key, its
# words (a word of text.tsv), its icon, the section of the tree it
# stands in, where it is and the folder under that. Where: `asset`, this
# program's own folder; `home`, the person's own; or a folder the system
# keeps for them, as the `dirs` crate knows it: desktop, document,
# download, picture, video, audio. A place the person makes their own is
# made when something is brought in (`make`). The drives (Volumes) are
# the system's own, found as the library opens. `-` for none.
